resources.string: Kapu only watches the apps you switch on in Kapu. When it sees a configured screen, it presses Back or Home. It does not read messages, passwords or images, and it has no internet access.
Your rules stay on this phone. The app has no internet permission, no account and no store, and backup is off.
Screen markers, comma separated. Empty: leave the app alone. A star (*): block the whole app as soon as it opens.
Kapu is off. Turn it on in Accessibility settings.
If Kapu is greyed out in Accessibility settings: App settings, the three dots at the top right, Allow restricted settings. Android 13 and later do this for every app installed outside a store.
Many phones stop background apps after a few minutes, and then Kapu gets no events. In App settings, set battery usage to Unrestricted.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO this is required: Battery saver, No restrictions, and Autostart on. Without it HyperOS freezes Kapu after a few minutes.
The action must be back or home (%1$s).
Restore the default rules? Your switches and markers are replaced.
The rules file was damaged. Kapu saved it as rules.broken.json and restored the default rules.
Has not closed a screen yet.
The app was updated since Kapu last closed a screen. If it gets through now, the rule may be broken.
Kapu is switched on, but Android is not running it. Switch it off and on again in Accessibility settings.
